author: Joe Scott
description:
Dealing with canker sores? Visit http://www.cankerboy.com to find out how to stop them.

Let’s just say we could build an Alcubierre warp drive and travel faster than light. Would that give us the ability to see into our own past? We explore that thought experiment, plus AI data centers, the growing socialist movement, and a heaping dose of existential dread. All on today’s Lightning Round video.
